title: Istio Services
description: Request rate, latency, and success rate for individual services in the Istio mesh.

dashboard.title: Istio Services
dashboard.description: Request rate, latency, and success rate for individual services in the Istio mesh.

variables.name: srcwl
variables.label: Client Workload
variables.query: query_result(sum(istio_requests_total{reporter=~"$qrep", destination_service=~"$service", source_workload_namespace=~"$srcns"}) by (source_workload) or sum(istio_tcp_sent_bytes_total{reporter=~"$qrep", destination_service=~"$service", source_workload_namespace=~"$srcns"}) by (source_workload))

variables.name: dstwl
variables.label: Service Workload
variables.query: query_result( sum(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", destination_service=~"$service", destination_cluster=~"$dstcluster", destination_workload_namespace=~"$dstns"}) by (destination_workload) or sum(istio_tcp_sent_bytes_total{reporter="destination", destination_service=~"$service", destination_cluster=~"$dstcluster", destination_workload_namespace=~"$dstns"}) by (destination_workload))
